## Surrender Value & Loss Calculation Methodology

### 1. Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV)
For conventional endowment and money-back plans:
$$\text{GSV} = (\text{Total Qualifying Premiums Paid} \times \text{GSV Premium Factor}) + (\text{Total Accrued Bonuses} \times \text{GSV Bonus Factor}) - \text{Survival Benefits Paid (if any)}$$

- **Minimum Eligibility:** 2 full consecutive years of premiums paid.
- **Taxes & Riders:** GST, extra underwriting premiums, and rider premiums are excluded from qualifying premiums.

### 2. Special Surrender Value (SSV)
Actuarially determined cash value:
$$\text{Paid-Up Sum Assured} = \text{Basic Sum Assured} \times \left(\frac{\text{Number of Premiums Paid}}{\text{Total Premium Paying Term}}\right)$$
$$\text{SSV} = (\text{Paid-Up Sum Assured} + \text{Vested Simple Reversionary Bonuses}) \times \text{SSV Factor}$$

### 3. Payable Surrender Value
$$\text{Payable Amount} = \max(\text{GSV}, \text{SSV})$$

### 4. Surrender Loss & Shortfall
$$\text{Capital Loss} = \text{Total Premiums Paid} - \text{Payable Surrender Value}$$
$$\text{Loss Percentage} = \left(\frac{\text{Capital Loss}}{\text{Total Premiums Paid}}\right) \times 100$$

---

## Premium Calculation Engine

### Base Premium Formula
$$\text{Annual Base Premium} = \left(\frac{\text{Tabular Rate per } 1000}{1000}\right) \times \text{Sum Assured}$$
$$\text{Rebated Rate} = \text{Tabular Rate} - \text{Modal Rebate} - \text{High Sum Assured (HSA) Rebate}$$
$$\text{Gross Installment Premium} = \text{Net Installment} \times (1 + \text{Applicable GST Rate})$$

- **GST Rate:** 4.5% for Year 1; 2.25% for Year 2 onwards (traditional life insurance in India).

---

## Maturity & Bonus Projection Engine

### Endowment Maturity Payout
$$\text{Estimated Maturity Benefit} = \text{Basic Sum Assured} + \text{Accrued Simple Reversionary Bonuses} + \text{Final Additional Bonus (FAB)}$$

- **Simple Reversionary Bonus:** Declared annually per ₹1,000 Sum Assured based on policy term.
- **Final Additional Bonus:** One-time terminal loyalty addition declared for policies with $\ge 15\text{ years}$ duration.

---

## Policy Loan Calculation Engine

### Loan Eligibility
- In-force policies: Up to **90%** of the Surrender Value.
- Paid-up policies: Up to **80%** of the Surrender Value.
- Minimum loan threshold: ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 depending on plan table.
